requirements.title: stable product identity — behavior
requirements.statement: The system shall provide the accepted behavior for stable product identity as defined by its parent capability, without substituting a weaker adjacent behavior.

verification_intent.positive_oracle: Demonstrate the stated stage readiness behavior on an exact product/baseline subject and retain attributable evidence.
verification_intent.negative_oracle: Supply a wrong-scope, missing, contradictory, stale, or invalid case relevant to stage readiness and prove the grader does not return a false green.

requirements.title: stage readiness — boundary
